tools.name: checkout_get_payment
tools.description: Get the full details of a payment (or payment session) by its id, e.g. 'pay_...'. Checkout.com: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_list_payments
tools.description: List your business's payments that match a given reference. Checkout.com: GET /payments (query parameters). For richer filtering use checkout_search_payments.

tools.name: checkout_search_payments
tools.description: Search payments using flexible query filters (this is a READ — it queries, it does not mutate). Checkout.com: POST /payments/search. Pass a `query` filter object and/or paging fields.

tools.name: checkout_get_payment_actions
tools.description: List all the actions (authorization, capture, refund, void, etc.) associated with a payment, latest first. Checkout.com: GET /payments/{id}/actions.

tools.name: checkout_get_payment_link
tools.description: Retrieve the details and status of a Payment Link by its id, e.g. 'pl_...'. Checkout.com: GET /payment-links/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_get_customer
tools.description: Get a customer's details (email, name, phone, saved instruments) by id 'cus_...' or by email. Checkout.com: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_get_instrument
tools.description: Get the details of a saved payment instrument (tokenized card / bank account) by id 'src_...'. Checkout.com: GET /instruments/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_list_disputes
tools.description: List disputes (chargebacks) against your business, most-recently-modified first, with optional filters. Checkout.com: GET /disputes.

tools.name: checkout_get_dispute
tools.description: Get all the details of a single dispute (reason code, amount, deadline, evidence status) by id 'dsp_...'. Checkout.com: GET /disputes/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_list_reports
tools.description: List the reports available on your account (settlement, payments, etc.) and their details. Checkout.com: GET /reports.

tools.name: checkout_get_report
tools.description: Get the metadata of a specific report (including its downloadable files) by id 'rpt_...'. Checkout.com: GET /reports/{id}.

tools.name: checkout_get_forex_rates
tools.description: Get the indicative foreign-exchange rates Checkout.com uses (e.g. for card payouts). Checkout.com: GET /forex/rates.

tools.name: checkout_create_payment
tools.description: CREATES a payment (request an authorization, or an immediate capture) — this MOVES MONEY: it charges a card / payment source. Checkout.com: POST /payments. Provide `amount` (minor units), `currency`, and a `source` object such as { type: 'token', token: 'tok_...' }, { type: 'id', id: 'src_...' } (a

tools.name: checkout_capture_payment
tools.description: CAPTURES a previously authorized payment — this MOVES MONEY: it settles the (full or partial) authorized amount. Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/captures.

tools.name: checkout_refund_payment
tools.description: REFUNDS a captured payment — this MOVES MONEY BACK to the customer (full or partial). Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/refunds.

tools.name: checkout_void_payment
tools.description: VOIDS (cancels) a payment that has been authorized but not yet captured — this releases the hold on the customer's funds. Checkout.com: POST /payments/{id}/voids.

tools.name: checkout_create_payment_link
tools.description: CREATES a hosted Payment Link the customer can pay through — this sets up a way to COLLECT MONEY. Checkout.com: POST /payment-links. Returns a URL to share with the customer.

tools.name: checkout_create_customer
tools.description: CREATES a customer record (which saved instruments and future payments can be attached to). This ADDS data to your account. Checkout.com: POST /customers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: checkout_search_payments, checkout_get_customer · Private data: checkout_get_report, checkout_create_payment, checkout_create_customer · Public sink: checkout_search_payments, checkout_get_customer, checkout_create_payment, checkout_capture_payment, checkout_refund_payment, checkout_void_payment, checkout_create_payment_link, checkout_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: checkout_search_payments, checkout_get_customer · Private data: checkout_get_report, checkout_create_payment, checkout_create_customer · Public sink: checkout_search_payments, checkout_get_customer, checkout_create_payment, checkout_capture_payment, checkout_refund_payment, checkout_void_payment, checkout_create_payment_link, checkout_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
